name: Climb And Zip🪂  [UPD 5]
desc:
Welcome to Climb and Zip!

In this exhilarating game, you and your pals will take on the challenge of conquering awesome heights, scaling legendary landmarks like the Statue of Liberty and the Pyramids of Egypt.

How to Play:
🧗Climb Challenges🧗
💰Collect Coins💰
